column1: # Which glyph the title bar of an app shows, and in which colour. Read by scripts/title-glyphs (it applies changes by itself, within a few seconds).
# Columns separated by TABS:  pattern (a regex on the app id, or the X11 class for XWayland apps, case-insensitive; the first line that matches wins)
#                             colour  (a palette slot of ~/.config/sway/end4pC-colors: x1 error, x2 tertiary, x3 secondary, x4 primary, x5 tertiary light,
#                                      x6 primary light, x11 secondary light, x12 tertiary dim, x13 secondary dim, x14 primary dark; or a #rrggbb colour)
